Ducati — a power-tool concept.

An industrial-design study: what would a cordless drill look like if a motorcycle maker built it? Sculpted red bodywork, a carbon-weave grip, a steel chuck — emotion, stance and speed brought to a hand tool. A wall of form studies leads to the hero render.

A concept study (not a Ducati commission). Industrial design — Anirudh Kapoor. A·44.
